name: handoff-triage
title: Handoff Triage
summary: Classify the reason for a human handoff, write the summary the patient consents to share, and declare the return path the resolution must respect.
when_to_use: The workflow has reached HUMAN_HANDOFF and a person must take it over
An agent returned terminal_error, or exhausted its retry budget on retryable_error, or could not resolve an outcome_unknown
A patient explicitly asked to speak to a person
Another skill called for escalation with technical_outage, no_match, missing_document, conflicting_sources, prolonged_unknown_booking or no_reliable_recovery

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: What failed and which agent raised it, with the evidence that supports it.

inputs.name: state_version
inputs.description: The version the workflow is at when the handoff is raised.

inputs.name: patient_context
inputs.description: What was being done, what was decided, and what remains open - the raw material for the patient-visible summary.

inputs.name: mandatory_conditions
inputs.description: Which of specialty_identified, approval_present, slot_valid held, plus blocking_reasons.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: reason_class, reason_detail, patient_visible_summary, consent_given_at, response_deadline_at, status.

outputs.name: ticket
outputs.description: Queued ticket carrying return_state and final_approval_still_required: true.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Reason code from the trigger, then human_owned once the ticket is claimed.

references.purpose: Per reason class: what it means, what the summary must contain, and what the resolution may and may not do.
